title: Agatak Muggaaqime Miraaca.
intro: kaxxa gexkalit kee niya garuq ummattah uddur, qibaadah xagana tekke. ta num, naharal mango mari yubleh suge, Yalli dooreh suge agat miraacisuh bohoy le qaduwwih saduh. Ken xaagi, numma miraaciino umman qammalsimak sugte aracal geytimtam hinnam taybulleem, diini cayla kee qilmih sumaq kinni.
clues: Anu Yalli dooreh sugem yi ummatta miraacah akkem oson kay gital qeebi aboonuh miraaca gorrisan wak.
Yi ummatta qimbol yi xagana esserte, gersi mari ken gadda akkek samad sababah mangom keenih taguudeh tanim cussut.
Yi miraaciini nummah asta, duma sugte nabiyyitteh raqteemih addat tan, sabhalal bahteh tan, diini sandug gacseenimi.
Anu inni qande daqar fan miraacisak, inki kobbaak daga takke lee yaaqubeenim keenik waasak, ken ammirtimiyya gibbateh.
Aqayyaareh lakal digga luk raqteh tan maritteh ixxima dagoom takkay immay, nanu caylale gaadule kee ken qandet garayne.
Yi amrih gubat, yi qandek qunxa num, yamixxige gaadule akke wayta, agiirinnal boodeh, bohoy le naqboyti shampiyoonuk yeyseh.

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Amoytiini mango gadda kee reeda luk xissiime.
qaduwwi chambise elle koositeeh, yalli maysri yeceeh.
outcome.answer: qaduwwi chambise elle koositeeh, yalli massori yeceeh.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
